class_name HandlingTests extends Object
## T2/T3: mass profile - accel/brake asymmetry, turn inertia, momentum slide,
## degraded-state mobility. Appends failed check names to the harness.

static var total_borrowed := 0
const EXPECTED_CHECKS := 9

const DT := 1.0 / 60.0


static func run(h, world: Node3D, kit: Dictionary) -> Array[String]:
	var fails: Array[String] = []
	var chk := func(cond: bool, name: String) -> void:
		total_borrowed += 1
		if not cond:
			fails.append(name)
			print("  FAIL: ", name)

	var info: Dictionary = kit.info
	var pilot: PilotController = kit.pilot
	var mech: MechController = kit.mech
	print("T2/T3 handling")

	# --- 30 m straight down lane A: pilot baseline.
	pilot.global_position = Vector3(-28, 0, 20)
	pilot.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	pilot.yaw = PI
	var fwd := ActorIface.make_command(Vector2(0, -1), Vector2.ZERO)
	var p_origin := pilot.global_position
	var t0 := 0.0
	while pilot.global_position.distance_to(p_origin) < 30.0 and t0 < 10.0:
		pilot.apply_command(fwd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		t0 += DT
	var pilot_top := Vector3(pilot.velocity.x, 0, pilot.velocity.z).length()
	print("  pilot 30m in %.2fs (top %.1f m/s)" % [t0, pilot_top])
	chk.call(pilot_top >= 8.0, "pilot is fast")

	# --- Mech same 30 m in the same lane.
	mech.global_position = Vector3(-28, 0, 18)
	mech.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.yaw = PI
	var origin := mech.global_position
	var t1 := 0.0
	while mech.global_position.distance_to(origin) < 30.0 and t1 < 25.0:
		mech.apply_command(fwd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		t1 += DT
	var mech_top := Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length()
	print("  mech 30m in %.2fs (top %.1f m/s)" % [t1, mech_top])
	# Straight-line ratio after the TF2/HD2 responsiveness retune; the full
	# lane-switch penalty (corners + turn inertia + re-acquire) is in Scenario A.
	chk.call(t1 > t0 * 1.25, "mech traverse clearly slower than pilot (%.2f vs %.2f)" % [t1, t0])

	# --- Brake distance well below spool-up reference: heavy but responsive stop.
	var v_max := Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length()
	var stop_d := 0.0
	while Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length() > 0.4 and stop_d < 50.0:
		stop_d += Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length() * DT
		mech.apply_command(ActorIface.empty_command(), DT)
		await h.physics_frame
	var spool_ref := v_max * v_max / (2.0 * MechController.ACCEL)
	print("  brake %.1f m vs accel reference %.1f m" % [stop_d, spool_ref])
	chk.call(stop_d < spool_ref * 0.75, "braking stronger than acceleration")

	# --- Turn response: human-flick pilot vs capped-inertia hull.
	pilot.global_position = Vector3(0, 0, -6)
	pilot.yaw = 0
	pilot.rotation.y = 0
	mech.global_position = Vector3(0, 0, -6)
	mech.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.yaw = 0
	var flick_cmd := ActorIface.make_command(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(8.0, 0))
	var rate_cmd := ActorIface.make_command(Vector2.ZERO,
			Vector2(MechController.YAW_RATE_MAX, 0))
	var tp := 0.0
	while absf(wrapf(pilot.yaw, -PI, PI)) < PI * 0.98 and tp < 10.0:
		pilot.apply_command(flick_cmd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		tp += DT
	pilot.yaw = 0
	pilot.rotation.y = 0
	var tm := 0.0
	while absf(wrapf(mech.yaw, -PI, PI)) < PI * 0.98 and tm < 10.0:
		mech.apply_command(rate_cmd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		tm += DT
	print("  180deg: pilot flick %.2fs | mech %.2fs (incl. view lag %.2fs)" % [tp, tm, mech.rig._view_lag()])
	chk.call(tm > tp * 2.0, "mech turn dramatically slower than a pilot flick")
	chk.call(mech.yaw_rate <= MechController.YAW_RATE_MAX + 0.02, "turn rate capped")

	# --- Momentum slide: new input does not teleport velocity.
	mech.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.yaw = PI
	mech.rotation.y = PI
	mech.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	while Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length() \
			< MechController.MAX_FORWARD * 0.95:
		mech.apply_command(fwd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
	var v_before := Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z)
	mech.apply_command(ActorIface.make_command(Vector2(1, 0), Vector2.ZERO), DT)
	var v_after := Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z)
	chk.call(v_after.length() > v_before.length() * 0.97,
			"hull keeps momentum under strafe input")

	# --- Degraded state mobility.
	mech.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.health.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(150))
	chk.call(mech.health.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DAMAGED, "damaged threshold")
	var vm := 0.0
	for i in range(240):
		mech.apply_command(fwd, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		vm = maxf(vm, Vector3(mech.velocity.x, 0, mech.velocity.z).length())
	var expected := MechController.MAX_FORWARD * MechController.DAMAGED_MULT
	print("  damaged top speed %.2f (expect ~%.2f)" % [vm, expected])
	chk.call(absf(vm - expected) < 0.25, "damaged mobility penalty applied")
	var dest_flag := [false]
	mech.health.destroyed.connect(func(_e: Dictionary) -> void: dest_flag[0] = true)
	mech.health.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(999))
	chk.call(dest_flag[0] and mech.health.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED,
			"mech destruction")
	return fails

extends SceneTree
## Reproduces the MANUAL input path: real InputMap actions fed through
## Input.parse_input_event -> InputSource.poll -> apply_command.
## Fails (exit 1) if firing at a dummy does not damage it.

const DT := 1.0 / 60.0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()


func _run() -> void:
	await process_frame
	var world := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(world)
	var kit := SimKit.assemble(world)
	var info: Dictionary = kit.info
	var pilot: PilotController = kit.pilot
	var mech: MechController = kit.mech
	var src := InputSource.new()
	world.add_child(src)

	# --- 1. Fire action reaches the command stream at all.
	var mb := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	mb.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
	mb.pressed = true
	Input.parse_input_event(mb)
	await physics_frame
	await physics_frame
	var cmd := src.poll(DT)
	print("fire_p after LMB press: ", cmd.fire_p)
	var ok := bool(cmd.fire_p)
	Input.parse_input_event(_release(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT))
	await physics_frame

	# --- 2. Mouse motion reaches the look command. Headless DisplayServer
	# never captures, so the handler is exercised directly (same code path
	# as windowed: _input -> _look_accum -> poll).
	var mm := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
	mm.relative = Vector2(100, 0)
	src._input(mm)
	var cmd2 := src.poll(DT)
	print("look after mouse move: ", cmd2.look)
	ok = ok and absf(cmd2.look.x) > 0.01

	# --- 3. Full pipeline: pilot fires at a dummy via real input.
	var d := DummyEnemy.make(world, Vector3(0, 0, 10), "pressure", info.core)
	d.speed = 0.0
	pilot.global_position = Vector3(0, 0, -2)
	pilot.yaw = PI
	pilot.rotation.y = PI
	# Aim the camera at the dummy like a player would (pitch down slightly).
	var eye: Vector3 = pilot.cam().global_position
	var aim := (d.global_position + Vector3.UP * 0.9 - eye).normalized()
	pilot.pitch = asin(clampf(aim.y, -1, 1))
	Input.parse_input_event(_press(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT))
	var frames := 0
	while frames < 600:
		if not is_instance_valid(d) or d.health.hp <= 0.0:
			break
		pilot.apply_command(src.poll(DT), DT)
		await physics_frame
		frames += 1
	Input.parse_input_event(_release(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT))
	var pilot_kill := frames < 600
	print("pilot input-path kill in %d frames, hp=%s" % [frames,
			str(int(d.health.hp)) if is_instance_valid(d) else 0])
	ok = ok and pilot_kill

	# --- 4. Same for the mech rotary.
	var d2 := DummyEnemy.make(world, Vector3(0, 0, 10), "pressure", info.core)
	d2.speed = 0.0
	mech.global_position = Vector3(0, 0, -14)
	mech.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.yaw = PI
	mech.rotation.y = PI
	mech.weapons.heat = 0.0
	var m_eye: Vector3 = mech.aim_eye()
	var m_aim := (d2.global_position + Vector3.UP * 1.2 - m_eye).normalized()
	mech.pitch = asin(clampf(m_aim.y, -1, 1))
	Input.parse_input_event(_press(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT))
	frames = 0
	while frames < 900:
		if not is_instance_valid(d2) or d2.health.hp <= 0.0:
			break
		mech.apply_command(src.poll(DT), DT)
		await physics_frame
		frames += 1
	Input.parse_input_event(_release(MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT))
	var mech_kill := frames < 900
	print("mech input-path kill in %d frames, hp=%s" % [frames,
			str(int(d2.health.hp)) if is_instance_valid(d2) else 0])
	ok = ok and mech_kill

	print("INPUT_PIPELINE_RESULT %s" % ("OK" if ok else "FAIL"))
	quit(0 if ok else 1)


func _press(idx: MouseButton) -> InputEventMouseButton:
	var ev := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	ev.button_index = idx
	ev.pressed = true
	return ev


func _release(idx: MouseButton) -> InputEventMouseButton:
	var ev := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	ev.button_index = idx
	ev.pressed = false
	return ev

extends SceneTree
## VS6 unit checks. Run:
##   godot --headless --path labs/mech --fixed-fps 60 --script res://tests/orchestrators/mech/run_tests.gd
## Exits 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL. Assert-based, no framework.

const DT := 1.0 / 60.0

var fails: Array[String] = []
var total := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	_run()


func _ok(cond: bool, name: String) -> void:
	total += 1
	if not cond:
		fails.append(name)
		print("  FAIL: ", name)


func _run() -> void:
	await process_frame
	seed(1234)
	var world := Node3D.new()
	root.add_child(world)
	var kit := SimKit.assemble(world)

	print("T1 interface")
	_test_interface(world)

	print("T1 interface")
	_test_interface(world)

	var handling_result: Array = await HandlingTests.run(self, world, kit)
	total += HandlingTests.total_borrowed
	fails.append_array(handling_result)
	if HandlingTests.total_borrowed < HandlingTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS:
		var skipped := HandlingTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS - HandlingTests.total_borrowed
		fails.append("HandlingTests ABORTED early: %d checks silently skipped" % skipped)
		total += skipped

	var weapons_result: Array = await WeaponsFlowTests.run(self, world, kit)
	total += WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed
	fails.append_array(weapons_result)
	if WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed < WeaponsFlowTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS:
		var skipped2 := WeaponsFlowTests.EXPECTED_CHECKS - WeaponsFlowTests.total_borrowed
		fails.append("WeaponsFlowTests ABORTED early: %d checks silently skipped" % skipped2)
		total += skipped2

	print("")
	if fails.is_empty():
		print("ALL %d CHECKS PASSED" % total)
		quit(0)
	else:
		print("%d/%d CHECKS FAILED:" % [fails.size(), total])
		for f in fails:
			print("  - ", f)
		quit(1)


func frames(n: int) -> void:
	for i in range(n):
		await physics_frame


func _test_interface(world: Node3D) -> void:
	var cmd := ActorIface.make_command(Vector2(1, -1), Vector2(0.5, 0), true, true, false, true)
	for k in ["mv", "look", "jump", "fire_p", "fire_s", "interact"]:
		_ok(cmd.has(k), "command has key %s" % k)
	var reqs: Array = ActorIface.weapon_requests(cmd)
	_ok(reqs.size() == 1 and reqs[0]["slot"] == "primary", "weapon_requests primary only")
	var reqs2: Array = ActorIface.weapon_requests(
			ActorIface.make_command(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2.ZERO, false, true, true))
	_ok(reqs2.size() == 2, "weapon_requests both slots")

	var hnode := Health.new()
	world.add_child(hnode)
	var states: Array = []
	hnode.state_changed.connect(func(s: int) -> void: states.append(s))
	var died_flag := [false]
	hnode.destroyed.connect(func(_e: Dictionary) -> void: died_flag[0] = true)
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(30))
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(30))   # 40% -> DAMAGED
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(20))   # 20% -> CRITICAL
	ActorIface.apply_damage(hnode, ActorIface.make_damage(25))   # dead
	_ok(hnode.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED, "health destroyed state")
	_ok(died_flag[0], "destroyed signal emitted")
	_ok(states == [ActorIface.ActorState.DAMAGED, ActorIface.ActorState.CRITICAL,
			ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED], "state ladder order")

class_name WeaponsFlowTests extends Object
## T4/T6: fixed-loadout behavior (spin-up, overheat, salvo/reload, AOE,
## armor roles) and the enter/exit/destroy/eject/restore flow.
## MECH-T1: no code path may touch a freed dummy — kill detection goes
## through signals, and EXPECTED_CHECKS catches silent module aborts.

static var total_borrowed := 0
const EXPECTED_CHECKS := 18

const DT := 1.0 / 60.0


static func run(h, world: Node3D, kit: Dictionary) -> Array[String]:
	var fails: Array[String] = []
	var chk := func(cond: bool, name: String) -> void:
		total_borrowed += 1
		if not cond:
			fails.append(name)
			print("  FAIL: ", name)

	var info: Dictionary = kit.info
	var pilot: PilotController = kit.pilot
	var mech: MechController = kit.mech

	# Reset mech from HandlingTests destruction.
	mech.health.repair_full()
	mech.set_husk(false)
	mech.control_enabled = true
	pilot.visible = true

	print("T4 weapons")
	mech.global_position = info.pad_pos
	mech.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.yaw = PI
	mech.rotation.y = PI
	mech.velocity = Vector3.ZERO
	mech.weapons.heat = 0.0
	mech.weapons.locked_t = 0.0
	# Aim ray tilted at a cluster center like the bot would.
	var eye := mech.global_position + Vector3.UP * 2.35
	var tgt := Vector3(0, 1.0, mech.global_position.z + 25.0)
	var aim := {"from": eye, "dir": (tgt - eye).normalized()}

	# --- Rotary: spin-up delay then sustained fire into a target wall cluster.
	# MECH-T1: kill detection via hull_changed signals — freed dummies are
	# never dereferenced (the old per-frame hp snapshot crashed on death).
	var targets: Array[DummyEnemy] = []
	var first_shot := [-1.0]
	var clock := [0.0]   # lambdas capture by value — shared array for time
	var tt := 0.0
	for off in [-2.0, 0.0, 2.0]:
		var d := DummyEnemy.make(world, Vector3(off, 0, mech.global_position.z + 25.0),
				"pressure", info.core)
		d.speed = 0.0
		d.health.hull_changed.connect(func(_f: float) -> void:
			if first_shot[0] < 0.0:
				first_shot[0] = clock[0])
		targets.append(d)
	var overheat_seen := false
	while tt < 7.0:
		mech.weapons.tick(true, false, aim, DT)
		if mech.weapons.locked_t > 0.0:
			overheat_seen = true
		clock[0] = tt
		await h.physics_frame
		tt += DT
	print("  rotary first shot %.2fs (spinup %.2f), overheat seen: %s"
			% [first_shot[0], MechWeapons.SPINUP, overheat_seen])
	chk.call(first_shot[0] >= MechWeapons.SPINUP * 0.95, "rotary spin-up delay enforced")
	chk.call(overheat_seen, "rotary overheats under sustained fire")
	chk.call(first_shot[0] < 7.0, "rotary actually damaged a target")

	for d in targets:
		if is_instance_valid(d):
			d.queue_free()
	await h.process_frame
	await h.process_frame

	# --- Rocket salvo: full burst, AOE across a cluster, forced reload.
	var cluster: Array[DummyEnemy] = []
	for off in [-1.5, 0.0, 1.5]:
		var d := DummyEnemy.make(world, Vector3(off, 0, mech.global_position.z + 22.0),
				"pressure", info.core)
		d.speed = 0.0
		cluster.append(d)
	var hp_sum := 0.0
	for d in cluster:
		hp_sum += d.health.hp
	mech.weapons.tick(false, true, aim, DT)   # rising edge triggers the salvo
	var rt := 0.0
	while rt < 1.6:
		mech.weapons.tick(false, false, aim, DT)
		await h.physics_frame
		rt += DT
	var hp_sum2 := 0.0
	for d in cluster:
		if is_instance_valid(d):
			hp_sum2 += d.health.hp
	print("  salvo dealt %.0f dmg (cluster had %.0f)" % [hp_sum - hp_sum2, hp_sum])
	chk.call(hp_sum - hp_sum2 >= 3.0 * MechWeapons.AOE_DMG, "rocket AOE covers the cluster")
	chk.call(mech.weapons.reload_t > 0.0, "salvo forces reload")
	chk.call(mech.weapons.rockets_display() == 0, "pods empty during reload")

	# --- Armor role split (MECH-T2: constants from the shared interface).
	var arm := DummyEnemy.make(world, Vector3(4, 0, mech.global_position.z + 22.0),
			"armored", info.core)
	arm.speed = 0.0
	var ah := arm.health.hp
	arm.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(22, ActorIface.Source.PILOT_GUN))
	print("  armored bullet loss %.2f (expect %.2f)"
			% [ah - arm.health.hp, 22.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_BULLET_MULT])
	chk.call(absf((ah - arm.health.hp) - 22.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_BULLET_MULT) < 0.01,
			"armored resists bullets")
	ah = arm.health.hp
	arm.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(32, ActorIface.Source.MECH_ROCKET))
	print("  armored rocket loss %.2f (expect %.2f)"
			% [ah - arm.health.hp, 32.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_ROCKET_MULT])
	chk.call(absf((ah - arm.health.hp) - 32.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_ROCKET_MULT) < 0.01,
			"rockets get the armored multiplier")
	# Weak-point: a hit AT the glowing node pierces armor (player skill check).
	ah = arm.health.hp
	arm.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(22, ActorIface.Source.PILOT_GUN, 0,
			arm.to_global(Vector3(0, 1.75, -0.99))))
	chk.call(absf((ah - arm.health.hp) - 22.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_BULLET_MULT * 2.5) < 0.01,
			"weak-point hit pierces armor")
	ah = arm.health.hp
	arm.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(22, ActorIface.Source.PILOT_GUN, 0,
			arm.to_global(Vector3(0, 0.8, 0))))
	chk.call(absf((ah - arm.health.hp) - 22.0 * ActorIface.ARMOR_BULLET_MULT) < 0.01,
			"body shot stays armor-resisted")
	arm.queue_free()

	# ---------------- T6: transition flow ----------------
	print("T6 transition flow")
	var src := InputSource.new()
	world.add_child(src)
	var hud := Hud.new()
	world.add_child(hud)
	var director := Director.new()
	director.kit = kit
	director.input_source = src
	director.hud = hud
	world.add_child(director)
	director.set_physics_process(false)

	pilot.visible = true
	pilot.control_enabled = true
	var pcol := pilot.get_node_or_null("Col") as CollisionShape3D
	if pcol != null:
		pcol.disabled = false
	pilot.global_position = mech.global_position + Vector3(3, 0.1, 0)

	director._enter_mech()
	chk.call(director.in_mech and not pilot.visible and not pilot.control_enabled,
			"enter: control switches to mech")
	chk.call(director.active_controller() == mech, "active controller is mech")

	director._exit_mech()
	chk.call(not director.in_mech and pilot.visible and director.active_controller() == pilot,
			"exit: control returns to pilot")

	# Destroy while piloting -> eject at pad + husk.
	director._enter_mech()
	mech.health.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(999))
	await h.physics_frame
	await h.physics_frame
	chk.call(mech.health.state == ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED,
			"mech destroyed under fire")
	chk.call(not director.in_mech and pilot.visible,
			"ejected to foot immediately")
	chk.call(pilot.global_position.distance_to(mech.global_position) < 8.0,
			"pilot dumped near the wreck/pad")
	chk.call(director.mech_respawn_t > 30.0, "long rebuild timer (loss must matter)")
	director._restore_mech()
	chk.call(mech.health.state != ActorIface.ActorState.DESTROYED
			and mech.control_enabled, "mech restored after rebuild window")

	# Pilot death respawn path.
	pilot.health.take_damage(ActorIface.make_damage(999))
	chk.call(director.pilot_respawn_t > 0.0, "pilot death schedules respawn")
	director._respawn_pilot()
	chk.call(pilot.health.state == ActorIface.ActorState.ALIVE
			and pilot.global_position == kit.info.pilot_spawn, "pilot respawns at spawn")
	return fails

param(
    [int[]]$Cells = @(64, 96, 128, 150),
    [int]$DurationSec = 15,
    [int]$BasePort = 24700,
    [string]$GamePath = "$env:TEMP\opencode\wave7\game",
    [string]$Godot = "G:\Godot\Godot_v4.7.2-stable_win64_console.exe",
    [string]$OutDir = "$env:TEMP\opencode\net_ladder_results"
)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Continue"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $OutDir | Out-Null
$rows = @()
$port = $BasePort

foreach ($n in $Cells) {
    $port++
    $hostLog = Join-Path $OutDir ("host_{0}.log" -f $n)
    $cliLog  = Join-Path $OutDir ("client_{0}.log" -f $n)
    $hErr = Join-Path $OutDir ("host_{0}.err" -f $n)

    # host: stays for DurationSec + setup margin, then dumps metrics and exits
    Start-Process -FilePath $Godot `
        -ArgumentList "--headless","--print-fps","--path","`"$GamePath`"","--","--quit-after-sec=$($DurationSec + 6)","--host","--port=$port","--crowd-count=$n","--ladder-print" `
        -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $hostLog -RedirectStandardError $hErr
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 2

    # client: joins, leaves gracefully at DurationSec
    & $Godot --headless --path "$GamePath" -- --connect=127.0.0.1:$port --leave-after=$DurationSec --ladder-print *>> $cliLog

    # harvest host steady-state line (last CROWDSTAT before client left)
    $stat = Select-String -Path $hostLog -Pattern "CROWDSTAT\] t=(?<t>[\d.]+) alive=(?<alive>\d+) snap_bytes=(?<b>\d+)" |
        Select-Object -Last 1
    if ($null -ne $stat) {
        $t = [double]$stat.Matches[0].Groups['t'].Value
        $alive = [int]$stat.Matches[0].Groups['alive'].Value
        $b = [int]$stat.Matches[0].Groups['b'].Value
        $rows += [pscustomobject]@{
            cell = $n; alive = $alive; snap_bytes = $b
            bps = [math]::Round($b * 15.0, 0); t_steady = $t
            host_log = $hostLog; cli_log = $cliLog
        }
    } else {
        $rows += [pscustomobject]@{ cell = $n; alive = -1; snap_bytes = -1; bps = -1; t_steady = -1; host_log = $hostLog; cli_log = $cliLog }
    }
    Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "*Godot*" } | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
}

$rows | Format-Table cell, alive, snap_bytes, bps, t_steady -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Host
$rows | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content (Join-Path $OutDir "summary.json") -Encoding utf8
echo "LADDER DONE -> $OutDir"

class_name SmokeTestBase
extends RefCounted

## Base for test_* suites. Convention deliberately mirrors GUT so migration
## later is mechanical: files test_*.gd, methods test_*, assert via ok().
## Every test_ method must execute at least one ok() — the runner treats a
## method with zero checks as failed (catches mid-method script aborts).

var checks := 0
var failures := 0


func ok(condition: bool, msg: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not condition:
		failures += 1
		printerr("    FAIL: " + msg)

extends SmokeTestBase

func test_midwave_replan_never_drops_or_rerolls_pending_batches() -> void:
	var cfg := MissionLoader.load_canonical()
	var safe: Dictionary = {}
	var greedy: Dictionary = {}
	for p in cfg.get("risk", {}).get("profiles", []):
		if str(p.get("id", "")) == "SAFE":
			safe = p
		elif str(p.get("id", "")) == "GREEDY":
			greedy = p
	var wave: Dictionary = cfg.get("waves", [])[0]
	var plan := WavePlanner.plan_wave(wave, safe, int(cfg.meta.seed), 1, 0)
	var now := 250
	var old_pending := WavePlanner.pending_batches(plan, now + 1)
	var greedy_plan := WavePlanner.retime_pending(plan, wave, greedy, now)
	ok(greedy_plan.batches.size() == old_pending.size(),
		"SAFE->GREEDY keeps every not-yet-emitted batch")
	var by_id := {}
	for b in old_pending:
		by_id[str(b.batch_id)] = b
	for b in greedy_plan.batches:
		var old: Dictionary = by_id.get(str(b.batch_id), {})
		ok(not old.is_empty(), "replan preserves authored batch identity")
		ok(str(b.role) == str(old.role) and int(b.count) == int(old.count),
			"replan does not reroll role/count")
		ok(int(b.at_step) > now, "replan never schedules a pending batch in the past")
		ok(int(b.at_step) <= int(old.at_step), "GREEDY may accelerate but never drop by stale time")
	var safe_again := WavePlanner.retime_pending(greedy_plan, wave, safe, now)
	var greedy_again := WavePlanner.retime_pending(safe_again, wave, greedy, now)
	ok(JSON.stringify(safe_again.batches) == JSON.stringify(greedy_again.batches),
		"SAFE/GREEDY toggling cannot reroll or repeatedly compress committed threats")
